definitions.state: open result in R at the close of the last bar closed at the checkpoint, on the quote that would close the trade (bid long / ask short), before exit slippage and swap
definitions.rest: final net R minus the net R of closing at the open of the next bar (lab engine, same order, exit_i = that bar, FP costs and swap): > 0 holding was worth more than cutting
definitions.mae_mfe: deepest adverse / best favourable open result over the bars held from open to close, the exit price being the last point; times in minutes from the fill
definitions.planned_life: scheduled time exit - fill time (noise30: 15:55 New York)

declared.status: declared before any variant was simulated; chosen from part 1 (2018-2021 anatomy, FP costs)

rules.EC: early cut: at the checkpoint, if the trade is still open and its open result u <= -x R, close it at the open of the next bar (time exit, market slippage); otherwise nothing changes
rules.NP: no-progress exit: at the checkpoint, if the trade is still open and u < y R (not ahead by y), close it at the open of the next bar; otherwise nothing changes
rules.HC: half cut: at the checkpoint, if the trade is still open and u <= 0 (not ahead), close HALF of it at the open of the next bar; the other half keeps the original exits. Trade result in R of the full planned risk = 0.5 x R(half kept) + 0.5 x R(half cut); the sleeve stays busy until the kept half exits

definitions.checkpoint: minutes t after the fill time (start of the fill bar), or a fraction f of the planned life (planned end - fill time, calendar time); the decision bar is the last M1 bar that STARTED before fill + t (it is closed at fill + t); the exit is executed at the open of the next bar in the frame
definitions.planned_end: the scheduled time exit of the order (its exit_i bar); noise30: 15:55 New York of the session (its band exits are signal exits)
definitions.state_u: open result at the close of the decision bar on the quote that would close the trade: long (bid close - entry) / risk, short (entry - ask close) / risk; entry = the simulated fill incl. slippage; risk = |entry - initial stop|
definitions.still_open: the trade has not been stopped and has not reached its time exit by the close of the decision bar
definitions.simulation_EC_NP: 1) every signal run independently (no_overlap False) on the same frame and costs: each order's own fill and path; 2) for every order where the rule fires, exit_i := decision bar + 1 (never later than the original exit); 3) run with no_overlap True (an earlier exit frees the sleeve for its next signal). Same in the x1.5 cost run (decisions recomputed on its quotes).
definitions.simulation_HC: the official trade set (no_overlap True, original exits); each trade rerun alone with exit_i := decision bar + 1 where the rule fires; R = 0.5 R_orig + 0.5 R_cut
definitions.broker_min_stop: an order whose stop distance is under 3 spreads at its fill bar is not taken (removed from the order list before any run, in each cost mode with that mode's spread)
definitions.costs: FP costs (r2.costs(sym), frame as stored) and x1.5 (spread x1.5 around the mid, both slippages x1.5, orders rebuilt on the widened quotes, swaps unchanged)
definitions.window: criteria on entries 2018-02-01 .. 2021-12-31; earlier in-sample years reported separately

candidate_criteria.a: exp_var >= exp_base + 0.20 x |exp_base|  OR  (|avg_loss_var| <= 0.80 x |avg_loss_base| AND exp_var >= exp_base); where exp_base <= 0 (GOLD_FRI_PM, 2018-2021 expectancy -0.007 R) the expectancy route also requires exp_var > 0
candidate_criteria.c: the improvement used in (a) (expectancy per trade, or average loss for the loss route) is better than the base in at least 3 of the 4 years 2018-2021
candidate_criteria.d: (a) and (b) also hold with costs x1.5 (variant x1.5 against base x1.5)
candidate_criteria.e: every one-step neighbour of the variant in its declared grid (same rule; next checkpoint or next threshold) has exp_var > exp_base and total_R_var >= total_R_base (FP, 2018-2021); for HC the other checkpoint
candidate_criteria.f: truncation test: for every order where the rule is evaluated, the decision recomputed from the frame cut right after the decision bar is identical
candidate_criteria.rank: if several variants of one sleeve qualify: larger 2018-2021 FP total-R gain first, then larger x1.5 gain

why_per_sleeve.noise30:us100: part 1: the only cells where cutting losers paid at first order are 5m state<=-0.5 (+3.0 R, 14 trades, 4/4 years) and 10% (about 30 min) state<=-0.25 (+5.4 R, 68 trades, 4/4 years); the only no-progress cell that paid is 60m y=0 (+2.3 R). Earlier years (2014-2017) show the opposite sign in those cells (-3.0 R, -2.8 R).
why_per_sleeve.ocm4:us100: part 1: early-cut cells that paid: 5m state<=-0.5 (+6.3 R, 38 trades, 3/4 years), 30m state<=-0.75 (+2.7 R, 15 trades, 4/4); no-progress at 50% of planned life (about 12:45 New York): y=0.25 +11.6 R (101 trades), y=0.5 +23.0 R (128 trades, 4/4 years), at 120m y=0.5 +5.3 R. In 2014-2017 the same 50% cells are negative (-3.1 R, -4.5 R).
why_per_sleeve.brk72_24h_wd:btcusd: part 1: early-cut cells that paid: 10% (144 min) state<=-0.25 +6.8 R (114 trades, 3/4), 50% state<=-0.5 +4.8 R (38 trades, 4/4); 25% state<=-0.5 lost 14.9 R. Every no-progress cell lost (tested to document it).
why_per_sleeve.nq_btc_follow:btcusd: part 1: early-cut cells that paid: 5m state<=-0.5 +1.7 R (13 trades), 30m state<=-0.75 +0.6 R (6 trades); 15m and 30m state<=-0.5 lost 5.6 and 6.8 R; every no-progress cell lost 25-60 R (tested to document it).
why_per_sleeve.F1_brk_ridge_filter:btcusd: part 1: cutting lost in almost every cell (-5 to -206 R); the exceptions are tiny (25% state<=-0.75 +0.5 R, 50% state<=-0.25 +3.0 R). Tested to document the user's rule on the sleeve with the highest expectancy.
why_per_sleeve.brk72_24h_wd:ethusd: part 1: early-cut cells that paid: 25% (6 h) state<=-0.5 +6.7 R (43 trades, 4/4 years), 50% state<=-0.25 +6.4 R; no-progress 25% y=0 +11.9 R (245 trades, 3/4), 50% y=0 +6.9 R, y=0.25 +6.2 R.
why_per_sleeve.F1_brk_ridge_filter:ethusd: part 1: early-cut cells that paid are small: 10% state<=-0.75 +1.0 R (4/4), 50% state<=-0.5 +2.2 R (3/4); every no-progress cell lost (-1.6 to -131 R).
why_per_sleeve.GOLD_FRI_PM:xauusd: part 1: the stop (3 x ATR) is far from the price over a 3-hour hold: at most 2 trades in 4 years reach -0.5 R and 2-16 reach -0.25 R; every cell is within +-3.1 R. Tested to document it (x=0.5 is expected to be almost a no-op).
why_per_sleeve.donch4h_stop:xauusd: part 1: early-cut cells that paid: 30m state<=-0.5 +1.9 R (7 trades, 3/4), 60m state<=-0.5 +2.2 R (14 trades, 4/4); no-progress 10% y=0 +0.4 R; all else lost.
why_per_sleeve.orb_asia_2d_buf10:xauusd: part 1: early-cut cells that paid: 120m state<=-0.25 +26.2 R (112 trades, 3/4 years; but 60m -4.2 R and 2013-2017 -6.4 R), 10% (about 6 h) state<=-0.5 +6.5 R (31 trades, 3/4); no-progress 50% y=0.25 +3.3 R, y=0.5 +5.6 R (85 trades; 2013-2017 -36.7 and -44.2 R).
